title: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Berries & Nuts
description: Layered Greek yogurt, berries, mixed nuts and seeds with a drizzle of maple syrup.
ingredients: Pinch of vanilla and sea salt
steps: Swirl vanilla and a pinch of salt through the yogurt.
Layer with berries and nuts and seeds in a glass or container.
Drizzle with maple syrup just before eating.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food Greek yogurt recipe collection

notes: Greek yogurt can carry up to 20g protein per 200g with minimal carbs — build this in a jar the night before for a grab-and-go breakfast.
